summary: Overall 2-page sheet geometry matches 1707-A April 2021 ENCS; targeted fixes needed for comb alignment in Items 9, 10, 11 and Page 2 Taxpayer's Name, blank overpayment Items 19 & 21 on print, Schedule 1 & 2 currency alignment/padding, and screen TIN branch truncation.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Item 9 (Registered Address, lines 1 and 2)
defects.what: Address prints as plain proportional text crossing the vertical comb ticks instead of one character per comb slot.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Item 10 (Contact Number) and Item 11 (Email Address)
defects.what: Both print as plain proportional text crossing vertical comb ticks, and Contact Number runs flush into the border beside Email Address.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Items 19 (Net Tax Payable/(Overpayment)) and 21 (Total Amount Payable/(Overpayment))
defects.what: Print completely blank when the computed amount is an overpayment (-799,061.01), even though the screen shows '(799,061.01)'.

defects.where: Page 2, header Taxpayer's Name comb box
defects.what: Name prints as plain proportional text crossing the vertical comb ticks instead of one character per comb slot.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedules 1 and 2 currency columns (C, D, E, F, and Row 5 TOTAL)
defects.what: Currency amounts are left-aligned flush against the left vertical borders instead of right-aligned with padding; text cells also touch left borders.
5-digit branch code '00000' truncates to '000...' in the readonly TIN pill.

defects.where: Part IV Schedules — combined rows 1-4 table validation banner
defects.what: Validation message 'Name of Corporate Stock holds 17 letters...' repeats 6 times verbatim in a single red block.

shared_changes_wanted: nsh/screens/form/: widen the 5-digit branch code box in the TIN control so '00000' does not truncate to '000...'.
nsh/screens/form/: deduplicate repeated per-cell validation messages in table banners.
